discovery.none: Manual selection only. No reliable advertised local name was established, and shared FFF0 must not activate this spec. After the owner selects an F15/F31, subscribe and require the F15/F31 frame dialect before publishing any reading; never identify every FitShow product by that service.

identification.notes: No safe automatic identity signal is documented. FFF0 is shared by many unrelated devices and is deliberately not an identification axis. After manual selection, require checksum-valid 0x02...0x03 frames with marker 0x51 and the documented lengths/field values.

device.name: Sportstech F15 / F31 treadmill (read-only)
device.notes:
Phone-direct FFF0/FFF1 telemetry for the F15/F31 profile. Frames start 0x02, end 0x03 and carry XOR in the penultimate byte. The XOR covers bytes 1 through len-3 inclusive, excluding the start, checksum and end. A fixed four-byte status poll on FFF2 is documented; no belt-control command is.
Full 17-byte status frames report operation mode, speed, elapsed time, distance and heart rate. The five-byte stopped fixture carries mode only. The six-byte starting fixture also carries unresolved raw byte 0x05 at offset 3; it is returned as offset_3_raw, not interpreted as speed. The public decoder publishes speed and heart rate zero for short frames, which is compatibility behavior and not proof of a physical measurement.
Consumer integration is identify_only: no dedicated F15/F31 frame handler ships here. The protocol blocks and stdlib vectors preserve implementation facts, not live app telemetry; supported status requires that handler.
INCLINE/CALORIE UNITS ARE UNRESOLVED. Byte 4 and bytes 9-10 are preserved as raw bytes only and deliberately have no calibrated entities, units or scale in this spec. Do not publish them as percent, calories or kcal.
Other FitShow/Sportstech bikes, ellipticals, rowers and treadmills can use different characteristics and payload layouts. The rower's 20-byte frames, alternate FFE1/FFE4/AE01 endpoints and authorization flows are excluded.

openness.notes: Protocol recovered by a public independent implementation and capture; no vendor wire specification was found.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: The independent local implementation connects over ordinary GATT without a proprietary pairing flow.

exclusivity.recovery: Close other fitness apps and reconnect; do not replay a vendor authorization exchange.

unpair.notes: No bond is created by this profile.

safety_advisory.detail: Do not infer a safe belt state from stale telemetry. Keep clear of the treadmill while validating a client, and do not replay initialization, authorization, speed, incline or firmware commands from another FitShow device.
safety_advisory.summary: The physical console and safety key remain authoritative; this spec never starts, stops or changes the belt.

credentials.notes: No account token, authorization key or workout credential is needed for this read-only path.

factory_reset.description: No genuine model-matched owner manual was acquired. Do not substitute a generic FitShow reset or another Sportstech model's procedure.
factory_reset.effect: No F15/F31 factory-reset operation or cleared-state list was established. Removing the safety key is not a factory reset.

methods.description: Connect, subscribe and validate delimited XOR frames; optionally issue only the fixed status poll.
methods.name: Direct FFF1 telemetry with strict frame checks

steps.action: Keep the treadmill stationary with the safety key under the owner's control and close other fitness apps.
Connect, verify FFF0/FFF1/FFF2 and enable FFF1 notifications.
steps.expect: Checksum-valid F15 frames arrive; do not write any initialization or belt command.

steps.action: If a poll is required, send only 02 51 51 03 on FFF2.
steps.expect: A status notification, not a belt start. Do not infer this poll's effect on other FitShow models.

steps.action: Reassemble and validate each frame before decoding the supported fields.
steps.expect: Bad delimiters, excess length, unknown types, bad XOR and truncated fields are rejected without updating state.

setup.notes: No account, cloud workout session, pairing key or authorization exchange is needed for passive decoding. The physical console remains in control.

rejoin.notes: BLE only: no treadmill network membership or client credential is used. Disconnect the previous central and revalidate the frame dialect.

steps.action: Disconnect the previous client and keep the physical console authoritative.
Reconnect and subscribe; send no session or authorization command.

testing.notes: No treadmill or motion-control command was used by this project. The public F15 capture and the independent implementation's four public frame envelopes support the read-only decoder. F31 support is reported by that implementation, not independently captured here. Tests are local stdlib transcriptions with malformed and fragmented input only.

entities.name: Operation Mode
entities.notes: 0 stopped, 2 starting, 3 running, 4 stopping; unknown modes are rejected.

entities.name: Speed
entities.notes: Full frames: byte 3 * 0.1. Short frames use the public decoder's compatibility zero.

entities.name: Elapsed Time
entities.notes: Full frames only, uint16 little-endian at offset 5.

entities.name: Distance
entities.notes: Full frames only, uint16 little-endian at offset 7 * 0.001.

entities.name: Heart Rate
entities.notes: Full frames: uint16 little-endian at offset 13. Short frames use compatibility zero.

evidence.open_questions: Verify incline and energy against console values before assigning units. Capture F31 separately and determine whether any poll is required for continuous telemetry on each firmware revision.
evidence.public_capture: syssi/esphome-treadmill-f15 includes an F15 btsnoop and JSON export. The research review cross-checked the public decoder and its four frame envelopes; no new capture or command was generated.
evidence.public_implementation: syssi/esphome-treadmill-f15 at 6e1617c1e505433ecb4c52ba9c99eff3097bcc22 supplied F15/F31 support, GATT endpoints, XOR/delimiter validation, full and short status handling and test fixtures. QZ's separate bike, elliptical and rower drivers establish that those protocols must not be merged into this spec.

initialization.notes: Subscribe before any status poll and validate every received frame before publishing state.

f15_f31_frames.description: Frame delimiter 0x02...0x03 with XOR at len-2. XOR is computed over frame[1:len-2] (bytes 1 through len-3 inclusive). Reject lengths above 108, bad delimiters, bad XOR, unknown operation/frame types and truncation.

full_status_fields.name: incline_raw_unresolved
full_status_fields.notes: Raw only; no unit, scale or entity is declared.

full_status_fields.name: energy_raw_unresolved
full_status_fields.notes: Raw only; do not label cal, kcal or apply the source's inconsistent 0.1 scale.

public_fixture_vectors.provenance: Public independent implementation fixtures, checked against its decoder and the public F15 capture; not new hardware traffic.

f15_f31_frames.short_frames: Enforce exactly (stopped, 5), (starting, 6), (running, 17) and (stopping, 17); reject every cross-combination and truncation even when delimiters and XOR are valid. The five-byte stopped fixture contains only delimiter, marker, mode, XOR and end. The six-byte starting fixture has an additional unresolved byte 0x05 at offset 3: return it as offset_3_raw and do not decode it as speed. For either valid short frame, publish mode and compatibility zeroes for speed and heart rate, leave full-frame-only distance/elapsed state unavailable, and never read beyond the payload. Longer partial telemetry layouts are not guessed.
f15_f31_frames.stream_reassembly: Notification callbacks may split or coalesce frames. Buffer from 0x02, validate a complete candidate against its expected known length and XOR, and resynchronize at the next 0x02 after a malformed candidate. Do not treat an embedded 0x03 as a terminator before the candidate's expected length and checksum have been checked.

remaining_unknowns: The six-byte starting fixture's offset-3 value 0x05 is unresolved and preserved raw; it is not a speed field.
Incline and energy units/scales are deliberately omitted pending console-labelled evidence.
F31 is supported by the public implementation but has no separate public capture in this research.
Long/fragmented frame variants beyond the public full and short fixtures and actual notification cadence.
Factory reset, pairing details, authorization, firmware update and every belt-control operation.

characteristics.name: Delimited status notifications
characteristics.notes: Decode with protocol_details.f15_f31_frames. Both full and short frames occur, so no single fixed characteristic format is declared.

request_status.description: Fixed four-byte status poll used by the independent implementation; does not encode a motion operation.

characteristics.name: Read poll write (no motor control)
characteristics.notes: Start/stop, speed/incline, authorization and session commands are intentionally absent.

services.name: Sportstech F15/F31 BLE service
services.notes: Shared 16-bit service; FFF1 carries delimited notifications and FFF2 carries only the fixed read poll declared here.
